scope.note: Host Python inventory only; not a deployment pin or production acceptance.

startup_observation.interpretation: -B prevents bytecode writes, not startup-time cached-code reads; encodings is present before the -c body executes.

host_python.os_modules: Modules observed in Windows System32 were not hashed; Windows code-signing/servicing remains the OS trust boundary.

acl_observations.finding: User and CodexSandboxUsers can modify; test venv is not a trust root.

parent_launcher.current_facts: Descriptor binds venv root/exe/hash, python home string, pyvenv.cfg hash, stdlib path strings; preflight hashes only venv python.exe and pyvenv.cfg and compares path strings.

guardian_anchor.current_retained_paths: Source root, venv executable, pyvenv.cfg, parent candidate manifest/pin/launcher, and candidate source-manifest files.

sealed_import.stdlib_modules: Loader/origin identity validation; no stdlib source/pyc/pyd content digest.
sealed_import.startup_risk: Startup modules such as encodings execute before bootstrap code can install the sealed finder.

source_review.deployment_status: Code-owned descriptor/runtime pins are zero and bootstrap/dependency seal files are still WIP; no deployment runtime is accepted.

minimal_design.manifest: One code-owned canonical manifest for the fixed CPython 3.11.5 AMD64 distribution; bind distribution identity, exact home/venv/pyvenv.cfg, exact -I -S roots, required startup pyc/source, python DLLs, stdlib importable files and required PYDs/DLLs; include exact recursive importable-file inventory and explicit present/absent python311.zip state. SystemRoot\System32 remains Windows OS trust, not whole-OS hashing.
minimal_design.prelaunch_seal: Before CreateProcess, validate manifest digest and pin; retain handles for all listed runtime files and every root/ancestor directory; reject reparse points, changed volume/file IDs, untrusted writer/delete/WRITE_DAC/WRITE_OWNER ACEs, unknown/extra importable files, and broad/writable DLL-search roots. Keep the lease through Job-empty/worker-exit; verify immediately before launch.
minimal_design.pyc: -B is not a read barrier. Protect and inventory the exact startup cache/source files before process creation; post-start loader/origin checks alone are too late.
minimal_design.dll_search: Pin expected base DLL/PYD paths and hashes; use only fixed executable/base runtime roots plus SystemRoot in PATH/DLL search; inspect loaded modules as supplementary evidence, not the sole Resume gate because suspended-process enumeration can be incomplete and lazy DLL loads occur later.
minimal_design.single_parser_ownership: sdk_merge owns one pure runtime-manifest parser/model; f14_bridge owns anchor pin/path binding, ACL and retained file/directory lease; native_contract bootstrap consumes only anchor-sealed facts and keeps source-only importer; guardian_qa only verifies anchor seal before CreateProcess and retains it until Job empty.
minimal_design.service_host_initial_trust: SCM service ImagePath/config and initial service Python/source must be installed in a SYSTEM/Admin-protected, externally pinned boundary; the already-running service cannot self-authenticate its initially executed Python code.

tests_and_limits.host_acl_read: Get-Acl on Anaconda base/runtime paths only; no changes made.
tests_and_limits.suspended_module_enumeration: Supplemental observation only; not a trust proof for modules loaded before/resume or lazy DLLs.
